faq.a1: Pick how you feel, what you want from the movie and the era you prefer: Mood-E combines these choices and queries the TMDB database to suggest up to 15 movies matching your mood. With "New picks" you get more titles with the same filters.
faq.a2: No. When you mark a movie as "Seen it", it's automatically excluded from Home recommendations and Trending. You can review your watched movies in the "My List" tab.
faq.a3: Everything stays on your iPhone: the watchlist and watched movies are saved locally only. No account is needed and no data is sent to external servers.
faq.a4: Go to Settings and turn on "New releases and movies in theatres". You'll get an alert when new movies arrive on TMDB and on the day a movie hits theatres. You can turn them off anytime with the same switch.
faq.a5: Your location is only used to show movies playing in your country and cinemas near you via Apple Maps. You can decline with "Not now": in that case the country set on your iPhone is used.
faq.a6: No, trailers always play inside Mood-E in a dedicated window, without ever leaving the app.
faq.a7: Titles, posters, ratings and trailers are provided by The Movie Database (TMDB). This app uses TMDB data but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
faq.a8: From the "Support" section in Settings tap "Report a problem": the GitHub page will open where you can describe the issue or request a new feature. We'll get back to you as soon as possible.

quiz.intro.msg: Six quick questions to discover your cinematic profile. The result gently refines your recommendations.
quiz.profile.animaMalinconica.desc: You love films that leave a mark: intense dramas, bittersweet endings and music that seems written about you. Every tear is a round of applause.
quiz.profile.animaMalinconica.title: Melancholic soul
quiz.profile.avventurieroCurioso.desc: Pure adrenaline: chases, impossible journeys and epic quests. You press play and the couch becomes a launchpad into the unknown.
quiz.profile.avventurieroCurioso.title: Curious adventurer
quiz.profile.cercatoreDiBrividi.desc: Suspense, mysteries and jumps off the couch: the more a film keeps you holding your breath, the happier you are. The dark of the theater is your natural habitat.
quiz.profile.cercatoreDiBrividi.title: Thrill seeker
quiz.profile.esploratoreDiGeneri.desc: No label can hold you: you jump from a documentary to a midnight cult without blinking. Your watchlist is a map of the world, and there is always new territory.
quiz.profile.esploratoreDiGeneri.title: Genre explorer
quiz.profile.romanticoIncallito.desc: Great love stories, kisses in the rain and happy endings with zero shame. You laugh, you cry, you rewatch the same scene three times — for you, cinema is a matter of the heart.
quiz.profile.romanticoIncallito.title: Hopeless romantic
quiz.profile.sognatoreNostalgico.desc: For you, cinema is a time machine: enchanted worlds, beloved classics and soundtracks that stay with you for days. Every film is a safe place to come back to.
quiz.profile.sognatoreNostalgico.title: Nostalgic dreamer

settings.appearance.footer: With "System" the app follows iOS light or dark mode, or you can force one. The palette changes the app's main color and background.
settings.community.footer: This counter is personal and visible only to you: no public leaderboards, no comparisons with others.

settings.journey.footer: Milestones are just for you: no leaderboards, no comparing with others.
settings.language.footer: The interface and movie data (titles, plots, genres) switch immediately to the selected language.
settings.legal.footer: This app uses data provided by TMDB but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB. Legal documents are currently available in Italian.
settings.list.footer: Movies marked as "watched" are removed automatically after a week. Once removed, they may reappear among recommendations. You can always remove them manually from the list.
settings.notif.alert.msg: To receive alerts about new releases, allow Mood-E notifications in iOS settings.

settings.notif.footer: Get an alert when new movies arrive on TMDB and on the day a movie hits theatres. You can turn them off anytime.
settings.notif.footer2: An evening check-in reminder, a gentle nudge about movies saved more than 5 days ago, and new releases matching your recent moods. Each alert can be switched off individually.
settings.notif.toggle: New releases and movies in theatres
settings.perso.footer: Unlock alternate icons and color themes by reaching milestones in the app.
settings.support.footer: To report a problem or request a new feature, open a request on our GitHub. We'll get back to you as soon as possible.
